concerns.text: FR-006 (A Priori Power Analysis) has no dedicated task. The spec requires a separate capability for future study design validation, but the current tasks only compute MDES as part of the audit (T013). Add a task (e.g., T025) that implements an a‑priori power analysis tool and produces a documented artifact.

SC-001 specifies a target extraction success rate of ≥ 60 %, yet no task verifies that this threshold is met. Introduce a verification task (e.g., T026) that asserts the extraction success fraction meets the requirement and fails if not.

SC-003 requires measuring total pipeline execution time against the CI job limit, but no task records or asserts this metric. Add a task (e.g., T027) that captures wall‑clock time for the full run and checks it against the allowed limit.
SC-004 demands measurement of memory usage against the RAM limit, yet no task performs this check. Add a task (e.g., T028) that profiles peak RSS and validates it is ≤ max_memory_gb from config.yaml.

The plan expects a contract test validating `audit_report.json` against `contracts/report.schema.yaml`, but no such task exists (referenced as T030 in the analyze report). Create a task (e.g., T030) that runs this contract test and verifies the schema.
Stale tag `T030` appears in the analyze report but no corresponding task is defined in tasks.md.
